sentences.text: The known fossil material consists of a fragmentary skeleton that lacks the skull.
The holotype proper includes the intercentrum of the atlas and the third through ninth cervical vertebrae.
Paratypes include fragmentary skull remains, nine teeth, pectoral girdle elements, a forelimb, and a hindlimb.
Kaijiangosaurus possessed megalosaurid-type teeth with few serrations near the tip.
The three claws on its hands were strongly curved.
The generic name Kaijiangosaurus refers to the River Kai.
The specific name lini honors the paleontologist Lin Wenqiu.
Some researchers suggest Kaijiangosaurus may be an ancestor of carnosaurs based on its cervical vertebrae showing both carnosaurian and primitive traits.
He originally classified Kaijiangosaurus within the family Megalosauridae.
Modern analyses suggest Kaijiangosaurus is a basal member of Tetanurae or possibly Averostra.
Kaijiangosaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 165 to 161 million years ago (Bathonian and Callovian stages), in what is now Asia.
Due to fragmentary remains, it is uncertain whether Kaijiangosaurus is a specific type of tetanuran theropod, though it may be a primitive carnosaur.
The validity of Kaijiangosaurus is debated, with suggestions that it is a synonym of Gasosaurus or Xuanhanosaurus.
